introHtml: Purple personal protection equipment offers a distinctive way to keep your team safe while reinforcing your brand identity. From antimicrobial lanyards and bandanas to sanitizer bottles with carabiners, these items stand out on any job site or event. Choosing purple adds visibility and a professional touch that standard safety gear lacks. Perfect for safety managers and HR directors looking to provide effective protection with a coordinated look.
